text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our second summer training camp with Smart 
Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her motivation was already more than 
enough, so—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's kick off the training camp☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! When you think of the ocean, 
you think of the beach; when you think of 
the beach, you think of sand!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of sand— it's me, the "Silence 
Suzuka of the Dirt"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A nickname that has caught on among the 
fans. Smart Falcon seems to be quite 
mindful of that name.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If we're borrowing Suzuka-chan's name, 
it'd be rude if we didn't get way 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because she was strong, Suzuka-chan became 
a star. She was able to captivate 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco wants to follow that example and 
become super-duper strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: With enough leg power to part the sea!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—At this summer training camp, I'm gonna 
seize the power of a champion!
